name: Adam
source:
A mysterious young man who meets [url=https://vndb.org/c139565]Eve[/url] on a bridge on a starry night. He asks [url=https://vndb.org/c139565]Eve[/url], who's ruled by thoughts of death, about the happiness of being alive.
